title: gbrain-read request contract (ATLAS-22, Slice 2)
description: Versioned request for the gbrain-read / graph-projection contract checker. Exposes exactly one capability: read_graph. The project is selected by an exact registry selector; title or fuzzy matching is impossible by construction. No read is performed by this contract: it defines the boundary, not a reader.

project.description: Exact project selector. The selector kinds are owned by the writer registry (config/project-registry.json, src/registry/resolve.mjs); an unresolved or ambiguous selector denies.
